table.name: agency
table.remarks: Agencies of every type that does not have its own table, told apart by agency_type: airports, voluntary hostels, youth offending teams, secure children's homes, immigration detention centres and so on. Migrated from NOMIS AGENCY_LOCATIONS.

column.name: agency_id

column.name: name
column.remarks: Short name of the agency, from NOMIS AGENCY_LOCATIONS.DESCRIPTION. Returned as description by /api/agencies. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: description
column.remarks: Full name of the agency, from NOMIS AGENCY_LOCATIONS.LONG_DESCRIPTION. Returned as longDescription by /api/agencies. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: contact
column.remarks: Name of a contact person at the agency, from NOMIS. Usually a named member of staff. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether the agency is in use. Inactive ones are kept so that historical records still resolve. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: accessible_access
column.remarks: Whether the building has accessible access: NONE, ACCESSIBLE, BY_ARRANGEMENT_ONLY or WHEELCHAIR_ACCESS. From the NOMIS disability access code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: agency_type

column.name: inactive_date
column.remarks: Date the agency was made inactive, if it has been. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: area
column.remarks: NOMIS area (AGENCY_LOCATIONS.AREA_CODE). References area.code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: geographical_area
column.remarks: Geographical area (NOMIS AGENCY_LOCATIONS.GEOGRAPHIC_REGION_CODE), for example a county. References area.code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: region
column.remarks: Region (NOMIS AGENCY_LOCATIONS.NOMS_REGION_CODE). References region.code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: all_agencies
table.remarks: View of every agency id in the register, of any type, with its name and type. The API uses it to check that a new agency id is not already taken.
table.viewSql: SELECT prison.prison_id AS agency_id, prison.name, 'PRISON'::text AS legacy_type FROM prison UNION ALL SELECT court.court_id AS agency_id, court.name, 'COURT'::text AS legacy_type FROM court UNION ALL SELECT hospital.hospital_id AS agency_id, hospital.name, CASE WHEN hospital.high_security THEN 'SECURE_HOSPITAL'::text ELSE 'HOSPITAL'::text END AS legacy_type FROM hospital UNION ALL SELECT probation_office.probation_office_id AS agency_id, probation_office.name, 'PROBATION_OFFICE'::text AS legacy_type FROM probation_office UNION ALL SELECT police_custody_suite.police_custody_suite_id AS agency_id, police_custody_suite.name, 'POLICE_CUSTODY_SUITE'::text AS legacy_type FROM police_custody_suite UNION ALL SELECT approved_premises.approved_premises_id AS agency_id, approved_premises.name, 'APPROVED_PREMISES'::text AS legacy_type FROM approved_premises UNION ALL SELECT agency.agency_id, agency.name, agency.agency_type AS legacy_type FROM agency;

column.name: agency_id
column.remarks: Id of the agency. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: name
column.remarks: Short name of the agency. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: legacy_type
column.remarks: Type of agency, as the register's type name: PRISON, COURT, HOSPITAL, SECURE_HOSPITAL, PROBATION_OFFICE, POLICE_CUSTODY_SUITE, APPROVED_PREMISES or one of the agency.agency_type values. Despite the column name, these are not NOMIS codes. [Sensitivity: NONE]
